list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM runs UNION SELECT environment FROM schedule_settings ORDER BY 1

value.title: Run healthcheck
value.confirmation: Run healthcheck for all configured agents now?

panels.title: Leave Request Agent
panels.description: Latest healthcheck for this agent in the selected environment; unlike the summary charts, this card is not limited by the time range. Healthy: non-empty answer and complete stream within the slow threshold. Slow: complete response above the threshold (10 seconds by default). Error: request error, empty answer, or incomplete stream. TTFT is time to the first answer token.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(r.status, 'Unknown') AS "Status", CASE WHEN r.finished_at IS NULL THEN 'No healthcheck yet' WHEN r.finished_at > now() - interval '1 minute' THEN 'Checked: just now' WHEN r.finished_at > now() - interval '1 hour' THEN 'Checked: ' || floor(extract(epoch FROM (now() - r.finished_at)) / 60)::int || ' min ago' WHEN r.finished_at > now() - interval '24 hours' THEN 'Checked: ' || floor(extract(epoch FROM (now() - r.finished_at)) / 3600)::int || ' h ago' ELSE 'Checked: ' || to_char(r.finished_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') END AS "Checked", 'Total: ' || COALESCE(round((r.duration_ms / 1000.0)::numeric,3)::text || ' s', '—') || ' (TTFT: ' || COALESCE(round((r.ttft_ms / 1000.0)::numeric,3)::text || ' s', '—') || ')' AS "Total", 'Stream: ' || CASE WHEN r.stream_complete IS TRUE THEN 'complete' WHEN r.stream_complete IS FALSE THEN 'incomplete' ELSE 'unknown' END AS "Stream",r.run_id AS "Run ID",r.dify_log_url AS "Dify log" FROM (VALUES (1)) seed(n) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT status,finished_at,ttft_ms,duration_ms,stream_complete,run_id,dify_log_url FROM runs WHERE kind='healthcheck' AND agent='leave' AND environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true

panels.title: Today's scheduled batches

targets.rawSql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' AS day_start), batches AS (SELECT e.scheduled_for,e.environment,CASE WHEN b.status='completed' AND COALESCE(b.failed_agents,0)=0 AND COALESCE(b.completed_agents,0)>=cardinality(e.agents) THEN 4 WHEN COALESCE(b.failed_agents,0)>0 OR b.status IN ('error','failed') OR (b.status='completed' AND COALESCE(b.completed_agents,0)<cardinality(e.agents)) THEN 1 WHEN now()>e.scheduled_for+e.grace_minutes*interval '1 minute' THEN 0 WHEN now()<e.scheduled_for THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS status_code FROM expected_batches e LEFT JOIN batch_progress b ON b.environment=e.environment AND b.scheduled_for=e.scheduled_for WHERE e.environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND (e.scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date=(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date), chart_points AS (SELECT scheduled_for, CASE status_code WHEN 0 THEN 0 WHEN 3 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 4 THEN 4 END::double precision AS status, status_code::double precision AS color, environment FROM batches UNION ALL SELECT day_start, NULL::double precision, NULL::double precision, NULL::text FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT day_start + interval '1 day', NULL::double precision, NULL::double precision, NULL::text FROM bounds) SELECT scheduled_for AS "Scheduled (VN)",status AS "Status",color AS "Color",environment AS "Environment" FROM chart_points ORDER BY scheduled_for

panels.description: Each dot is a healthcheck batch scheduled today in Vietnam time (00:00–24:00). Bottom to top: Missed = not completed after the grace period; Waiting = scheduled time has not arrived; Pending = within the grace period; Error = an agent failed or the batch has missing results; Complete = all expected agents finished without errors. The grace period comes from the schedule's grace_minutes setting.

panels.title: Response latency (s)
panels.description: Each point is the total duration of one healthcheck request, from sending the request to completing the response, converted from milliseconds to seconds. The selected time range, environment, and agent filters apply. Higher points mean slower responses.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, agent AS metric, (duration_ms / 1000.0) AS duration_s FROM runs WHERE kind='healthcheck' AND environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Time to first answer token (s)
panels.description: TTFT (Time to First Token) measures the time from sending a request to the first answer token, in seconds. It shows when the answer starts; Total time shows when the request finishes. A run without a first answer token has no TTFT value.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, agent AS metric, (ttft_ms / 1000.0) AS ttft_s FROM runs WHERE kind='healthcheck' AND environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Runs by health status
panels.description: Each bar counts an agent's healthcheck runs in the selected time range. Healthy, Slow, and Errors are counts of runs by status and together make the total. Healthy = complete response within the slow threshold; Slow = complete response above it; Error = request error, empty answer, or incomplete stream.

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent || ' · ' || count(*)::text || ' runs' AS "Agent",count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='Healthy') AS "Healthy",count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='Slow') AS "Slow",count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='Error') AS "Errors" FROM runs WHERE kind='healthcheck' AND environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY agent ORDER BY agent

panels.title: Total time percentiles (P50 → P95)
panels.description: Total-time percentiles by agent, using only runs with a measured duration. P50 is the median: about half of runs finish within this time. P95 is the time within which about 95% of runs finish. The blue segment spans 0 to P50; the purple segment spans P50 to P95, so it is the additional tail, not another cumulative P95.

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent || ' · P50 ' || round((percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY duration_ms) / 1000.0)::numeric,3)::text || 's · P95 ' || round((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY duration_ms) / 1000.0)::numeric,3)::text || 's' AS "Agent",round((percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY duration_ms) / 1000.0)::numeric,3) AS "P50 (s)",round(((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY duration_ms) - percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY duration_ms)) / 1000.0)::numeric,3) AS "P50–P95 (s)" FROM runs WHERE kind='healthcheck' AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY agent ORDER BY agent

panels.title: Healthcheck runs and errors
panels.description: Up to 200 recent healthchecks matching the filters. Finished (VN) is completion time in Vietnam; Trigger identifies scheduled or manual runs; TTFT is time to the first answer token; Total is the full duration. Select a Run ID for its details, or View log for the Dify log when available.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(finished_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS "Finished (VN)",agent AS "Agent",trigger AS "Trigger",status AS "Status",round((ttft_ms / 1000.0)::numeric,3) AS "TTFT (s)",round((duration_ms / 1000.0)::numeric,3) AS "Total (s)",error AS "Error",run_id AS "Run ID",CASE WHEN dify_log_url ~ '^https?://' THEN '[View log](' || replace(dify_log_url,')','%29') || ')' ELSE NULL END AS "Dify log" FROM runs WHERE kind='healthcheck' AND environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Recent tool calls
panels.description: Up to 200 recent tool calls from the filtered healthchecks. Turn is the conversation turn; Tool order is the call's position within that turn. Duration appears only when reliable timing is available. A blank duration means it could not be measured accurately, not zero seconds. Timing source identifies where the timing came from.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(r.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS "Started (VN)",r.agent AS "Agent",t.turn_index+1 AS "Turn",t.tool_index+1 AS "Tool order",t.name AS "Tool",t.status AS "Status",round((t.duration_ms / 1000.0)::numeric,3) AS "Duration (s)",t.timing_source AS "Timing source",r.run_id AS "Run ID" FROM tool_calls t JOIN runs r USING(run_id) WHERE r.kind='healthcheck' AND r.environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) ORDER BY r.started_at DESC,t.tool_index LIMIT 200
